name: Larry Heard
hook: Recorded "Can You Feel It" on two cassette decks in one pass, and invented deep house almost by accident.
blurb: Heard recorded "Can You Feel It" in 1984 using just a synthesizer, a drum machine and two cassette decks to layer the parts, since he had no multitrack recorder. Released under the name Mr. Fingers in 1986, it was softer and jazzier than most house records of the time, and it started the deep house sound. It is often put next to Derrick May's "Strings of Life" as the other great emotional landmark, one for deep house and one for techno. Heard's group Fingers Inc. released "Another Side" in 1988, arguably the first house album made as one whole long work rather than a collection of club tracks. Like many artists on Trax, Heard later took the label to court over royalties he had not been paid.
